result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case.

The change is one condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, in the subquery of `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java`. It is the same filter the per-quarter and per-weekday purchase-order reports use. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCount*` and `DemoScenarioTest` (the exact test class names are a guess) with `mvn -q -o test`. The run printed nothing, which I read as no failures.
